# Ezekiel 13 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 13:4 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Like-foxes in-ruins your-prophets have-been, O-Israel. |
| LOGOS | Your prophets have been like jackals among ruins, O Israel. |
| PNEUMA | Israel, your prophets are like jackals scavenging in the ruins. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 13:3 (overlap: 4%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Thus says the-Lord YHWH: 'Woe to-the-prophets, the-foolish-ones, who-follow their-own spirit and-what-they-have-not-seen!' |
| LOGOS | Thus says the Lord GOD, Woe to the foolish prophets who follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing! |
| PNEUMA | The Lord GOD says: How terrible it will be for these foolish prophets who follow their own imagination and have never actually seen anything from Me! |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 13:10 (overlap: 4%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Because, yes-because, they-led-astray My-people, saying, 'Peace!' — and-there-is no peace; and-one [is]-building a-wall, and-behold-them plastering-it [with]-whitewash. |
| LOGOS | Precisely because they have misled My people, saying, 'Peace,' when there is no peace, and because, when the people build a wall, these prophets smear it with whitewash, |
| PNEUMA | They have misled My people by saying, 'Everything is fine!' — when nothing is fine. When people build a flimsy wall, these prophets come along and slap some whitewash on it. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 13:5 (overlap: 4%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | You-have-not-gone-up into-the-breaches, and-you-have-not-built-up a-wall for-the-house-of Israel to-stand in-the-battle on-the-day-of YHWH. |
| LOGOS | You have not gone up into the breaches, or built up a wall for the house of Israel, that it might stand in battle in the day of the LORD. |
| PNEUMA | They haven't stepped into the gaps in the wall. They haven't done anything to repair the defenses so Israel could stand strong in the day of the LORD's battle. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 13:6 (overlap: 4%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | They-saw vanity and-divination-of-lies, the-ones-saying, 'Declares YHWH,' and-YHWH has-not-sent-them, and-they-wait for-[the]-confirmation-of [the]-word. |
| LOGOS | They have seen false visions and lying divinations. They say, 'Declares the LORD,' when the LORD has not sent them, and yet they expect Him to fulfill their word. |
| PNEUMA | Their visions are fake, and their predictions are lies. They say, 'The LORD declares,' but the LORD never sent them. And yet they actually expect their words to come true! |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 13:7 (overlap: 5%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Have-you-not-seen a-vision-of vanity, and-divination-of-lies have-you-not-spoken? And-you-say, 'Declares YHWH,' and-I — I-have-not-spoken." |
| LOGOS | Have you not seen a false vision and uttered a lying divination, whenever you have said, 'Declares the LORD,' although I have not spoken?" |
| PNEUMA | Haven't your visions been false? Haven't your predictions been lies? You keep saying, 'The LORD declares,' but I never said a word to you." |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.
